description: Core v7 layered/epigraph-clean ablations on the current clean 3-class graph relation dataset. Runtime masks keep .pt graph tensors immutable.

experiments.name: M00_full_ce_ohem
experiments.hypothesis: Full v7 multimodal graph model is the baseline for structure relation prediction.
experiments.purpose: Full features + GATv2 + directional deep head + CE/OHEM.

experiments.name: M01_no_message_passing
experiments.hypothesis: If graph context matters, removing GAT message passing hurts parent-child and ambiguous merge.
experiments.purpose: Project nodes and classify candidate edges with no graph convolution.

experiments.name: M02_no_symmetry_terms
experiments.hypothesis: Directional symmetry-breaking terms Hu-Hv and Hu*Hv are important for directed parent-child.

experiments.name: M03_shallow_predictor
experiments.hypothesis: Rare merge needs a deeper edge predictor; a shallow head should underfit boundary subtleties.
experiments.purpose: Keep GATv2 but reduce predictor to one hidden layer.

experiments.name: M04_type_aware_message_mask
experiments.hypothesis: Message passing helps hierarchy but pollutes MERGE; masking noisy cross-layer propagation should keep PARENT_CHILD strong while recovering MERGE precision/recall.
experiments.purpose: Use all candidate edges for classification, but restrict GAT propagation to type/layout-compatible edges via data.message_edge_mask.

experiments.name: M05_y_network_dual_head
experiments.hypothesis: MERGE needs unpolluted local features while PARENT_CHILD benefits from GNN propagation; a Y-network should preserve both signals.
experiments.purpose: Bypass GNN for MERGE logits using raw projected node features, while PARENT/NONE logits use propagated GAT states.

experiments.name: M06_y_network_plus_merge_gate
experiments.hypothesis: A class-specific MERGE gate should reduce false positive contractions without removing edges needed for PARENT_CHILD.
experiments.purpose: Use the Y-network and suppress only the MERGE logit for edges failing TreeDecoder-compatible physical merge gates.

experiments.name: M07_y_network_plus_gaussian_edge_feature
experiments.hypothesis: A Gaussian proximity cue should help the propagated PARENT/NONE branch downweight physically distant candidate edges without forcing a custom attention kernel.
experiments.purpose: Use the Y-network and append a runtime gaussian_proximity feature derived from center_distance to the effective edge_attr.

experiments.name: F00_no_scibert
experiments.hypothesis: Layout alone is not enough for paragraph continuation and semantic ambiguity.

experiments.name: F01_semantic_only
experiments.hypothesis: Text semantics alone cannot solve columns, visual hierarchy, and layout boundaries.
experiments.purpose: Keep SciBERT, zero all non-semantic node features.

experiments.name: F02_no_reading_flow
experiments.hypothesis: v7 band/column/flow features protect against reading-order inversion.
experiments.purpose: Remove scroll-y, sequence, column, layout-layer, flow-context and matching edge flow cues.

experiments.name: F03_raw_mineru_flow
experiments.hypothesis: If v7 reading-flow repair matters beyond MinerU's native extraction order, keeping flow features but deriving them from raw original_index should reduce structure quality.
experiments.purpose: Keep reading-flow features, but rebuild scroll/index/pseudo-y, flow context, candidate edges, and edge index bins from MinerU original_index instead of repaired layout_flow_order.

experiments.name: E00_no_punctuation
experiments.hypothesis: Terminal punctuation and hyphen probes are high-precision merge boundary signals.
experiments.purpose: Remove source terminal punctuation and hyphen edge features.

experiments.name: E01_no_gutter_overlap
experiments.hypothesis: Gutter/overlap features suppress cross-column false merge.

experiments.name: T00_no_ohem
experiments.hypothesis: Without OHEM, the long-tail NONE distribution washes out positive edges.
experiments.purpose: Full model, plain CE, no OHEM.
